name: Resistor Environment QA 6

examples.input: A network has a \SI{5}{\volt} cell.  {"topology": {"resistors": {"R1": 2.5, "R2": 5.0, "R3": 2.0, "R4": 3.0}, "connections": [["A", "D", "R3"], ["D", "B", "R4"], ["A", "B", "R2"], ["B", "C", "R1"]]}}, Resistance are in ohms.
